findings.highlight: I’m going to guess about something bad.
findings.evidenceJa: とてつもなく悪い予感を口にするんだが
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he is about to voice an extremely bad premonition.
findings.explanation: Guess about something bad is malformed and weakens the comic dread before his accusation.

findings.highlight: no wonder he never gets enough of talking to me
findings.evidenceJa: どうりで懲りずに話しかけてくる筈だ
findings.governingReading: Rin realizes why Shinji keeps approaching and speaking to her without being discouraged by rejection.
findings.explanation: The English turns persistence despite discouragement into an appetite for conversation.

findings.highlight: I can’t get in the mood unless I’m setting the mood
findings.evidenceJa: やるなら自分からっていうか
findings.governingReading: Rin says that if a contest or advance is going to happen, she has to initiate it herself.
findings.explanation: Setting the mood replaces agency and competitive initiative with an unrelated romantic-emotional idiom.
